scope: Independent visual review only of assigned PDF pages 106–145 (40 pages); this is not approval of all 150 pages.
review_method: Each assigned page was individually rendered from the fixed PDF and individually opened with view_image, in batches of five separate images. No montage-only review.
checks: Article/full Japanese translation/editorial reference summary roles are explicitly distinguished.

Single-line titles, quote backgrounds, final lines, readable type sizes, source separation and page-edge containment were inspected on every assigned page.
